summary: SunCar Technology Group filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, disclosing a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notification received July 27, 2026, covering non-compliance from June 10 to July 24, 2026. The company has until January 25, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a $1.00 closing bid for ten consecutive business days; possible reverse stock split may be considered if needed. The filing is administrative, not a special situation.
